card.name: Digits and names inside combination-drug doses
card.fires_on: Partway through combination-product strengths and long salt or drug names, such as the digits of lumacaftor 100 mg/ivacaftor, or the middle of dextroamphetamine and potassium sulfate. Also on digits in repeated number tables.

modes.label: Number tables
